test_title: PYST 13: RRB Group D - Mathematics (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: One pipe can fill a tank in 9 minutes while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 90 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-half of the tank?
solution:
**Given:**

Filling pipe time = 9 minutes

Emptying pipe time = 90 minutes

Required work = 1/2 tank

**Formula Used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency = LCM ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ LCM of 9 and 90 = 90

⇒ Efficiency of filling pipe = 90 ÷ 9 = 10

⇒ Efficiency of emptying pipe = 90 ÷ 90 = 1

⇒ Net efficiency = 10 − 1 = 9

⇒ Total work = 90

⇒ Required work = 90 ÷ 2 = 45

⇒ Time = 45 ÷ 9 = 5

**∴ The correct answer is 5.**
